ranked.headline: Transferable and calibrated prediction of drug and perturbation responses
ranked.summary: Drug and perturbation response models are now judged on transfer to unseen contexts and on calibrated uncertainty.

ranked.headline: Computational methods resolve cell identity and quality in single-cell transcriptomes
ranked.summary: Growing integrated single-cell atlases require annotation that handles unknown types, pooled samples, and ambient RNA contamination.

ranked.headline: Bayesian and tree-based models infer single-cell lineage trees and fate transitions
ranked.summary: Sequential CRISPR lineage recordings now support joint Bayesian inference of single-cell phylogenies and proliferation dynamics.

ranked.headline: Learned protein models are being tested against stringent regimes and new design tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test learned protein models on mutational distance, epitope conditioning, and kinetics-linked prediction under targeted regimes.

ranked.headline: ML models guide design of nucleic acid, capsid, and genome-editing components
ranked.summary: Protein language models and sequence optimizers are now tested against deep sequencing and large-scale functional screens.

ranked.headline: Curvature and graph priors sharpen protein-ligand and ADME property prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published model inject curvature, graph, and pretraining priors into affinity and ADME prediction models.

ranked.headline: Learned and coarse-grained models are sampling protein conformational ensembles
ranked.summary: Learned ensemble generation is now being checked against explicit molecular simulation for protein state populations.

ranked.headline: Evaluation choices and held-out chemistry reorder drug-response model rankings
ranked.summary: Biomolecular foundation and deep models are now being judged on out-of-distribution chemistry, leakage, and identifiability rather than architecture alone.

ranked.headline: Models integrate methylation, chromatin states and sequence to predict regulation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair sequence models with methylation, histone marks and personal genomes to predict regulatory activity.

ranked.headline: Regulatory and spatial graph models are linking cell states to dynamics and perturbation
ranked.summary: Gene regulatory and spatial neighborhood priors are now built directly into deep models for trajectories, imputation and perturbation prediction.

ranked.headline: Feature-driven and bias-aware models sharpen sequence-based biological inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication apply ML and statistical models directly to sequencing and primer data to improve assay and inference accuracy.

ranked.headline: Embedding-based and domain-restricted search cut the cost of orthologous gene inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprint and published methods replace all-vs-all sequence comparison with embeddings and domain-architecture restriction to scale orthology inference.

ranked.headline: Cortical topography imposed on learned models of fMRI brain activity
ranked.summary: Recent preprints constrain foundation and transformer models with cortical topography to yield brain-like representations, dynamics, and connectomes.

ranked.headline: Explicit neural models are judged by population geometry and drift statistics
ranked.summary: Explicit mechanistic models are now being evaluated against internal population geometry and tuning drift statistics across neural systems.

ranked.headline: Reference-free and distribution-aware methods for genome inference and benchmarking
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published OrthoFinder update address coverage-limited inference, benchmarking inputs, and phylogenomic scalability.

ranked.headline: LLM agents and Bayesian tools are being coupled to biomedical analysis workflows
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair LLM agents with pathway, literature, and statistical scoring tools for biomedical hypothesis work.

ranked.headline: Auditing and correcting technical distortions in long-read, probe, and ATAC-seq data
ranked.summary: Sequencing-derived measurements need sample-specific or per-observation checks before their biological interpretation can be trusted.

ranked.headline: Compact k-mer indices and protein language models advance microbial sequence annotation
ranked.summary: Targeted and taxonomic sequence classifiers now report large memory and runtime gains alongside benchmarked accuracy.

ranked.headline: Predicted and fixed-backbone structures gated by audit layers for functional calls
ranked.summary: Structure-derived predictions are paired with constraint and audit layers before functional claims in redesign, aggregation and variant work.

ranked.headline: Bayesian and neural methods refine genetic prediction and annotation-stratified inference
ranked.summary: Recent work extends GWAS-based priors, polygenic scores, and longitudinal mixed models to multi-population, covariate-aware, and time-varying genetic settings.

ranked.headline: Graph and hypergraph models predict compound activity, synergy, and hepatotoxicity
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test encoding choices and graph-based architectures for screening, synergy, and toxicity prediction across bacterial and human targets.

ranked.headline: Inferring RNA-based regulation from interaction, network, and composition data
ranked.summary: Interaction and network inference are increasingly coupled to fate and localization readouts, sharpening candidate regulator nomination.

ranked.headline: Simulations resolve conformational gating in membrane transporters and signaling proteins
ranked.summary: Adaptive, Markov state, and multi-scale simulations are resolving transition pathways across transporters, channels, and inflammasome proteins.

ranked.headline: Plant genome comparisons link polyploid diploidization and arid adaptation to repeats
ranked.summary: Recent plant genome studies across polyploids, tree grapes, and a medicinal species extend comparative tools to chromosome-scale and k-mer-based analyses.

ranked.headline: AI models infer continuous disease and aging trajectories from static measurements
ranked.summary: Cross-sectional cohorts and single-cell data now yield pseudo-temporal disease and aging trajectories with reversibility tests.

ranked.headline: Missense variant resources pair functional labels with structural and population context
ranked.summary: Public expert-curated benchmarks and structure-mapped variant tools now pair functional labels with population and drug-binding context.

ranked.headline: Genomic pipelines link microbial genotype to metabolism, typing, and resistance
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair curated metabolic models and long-read metagenomics with large-scale genotyping and AMR evolutionary inference.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings encode taxonomy, nativeness and training memorization
ranked.summary: Multi-species and holdout benchmarks now expose taxonomic shortcuts and memorization in protein language models.

ranked.headline: Tumour evolution-derived ground truth for benchmarking cancer whole-genome sequencing
ranked.summary: SCOUT supplies over 200 synthetic cancer genomes with evolutionary ground truth, a resource for benchmarking somatic variant, CNV and signature methods.

ranked.headline: Integrated software frameworks for analyzing multi-omic and direct RNA sequencing data
ranked.summary: Standardized pipelines now extend omics analysis from mass spectrometry to Nanopore RNA modification and single-cell multi-omic atlases.

ranked.headline: Resolving proteoform-level variation from bottom-up and top-down mass spectrometry data
ranked.summary: Recent tools pair peptide-level differential statistics and label-free quantification with intact-protein proteoform characterization in mass spectrometry.

ranked.headline: Scoring, docking and MD hardware advance protein-ligand and lipid-complex modeling
ranked.summary: Billion-scale docking, dedicated MD hardware and lipid-complex benchmarks are being validated against established methods.

ranked.headline: Ligand-dependent allostery and protein-glass dynamics in enzymes and respiratory complexes
ranked.summary: Family-scale salt-bridge classification and many-body allosteric metrics extend conformational analysis beyond single-protein case studies.

ranked.headline: Connectivity and intrinsic currents govern oscillation regimes in cortical circuits
ranked.summary: Recent June 2026 work reduces detailed circuit models to low-dimensional accounts of oscillation regime and synchrony.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict metabolic flux and genome-scale network behavior
ranked.summary: mFLIP predicts flux intervals in under a second from FVA data, while CytoGem-XAI adds interpretable reaction-level hypergraph modeling.

ranked.headline: Explicit probabilistic models applied to mutational, miRNA, and spatial proteomic data
ranked.summary: Recent work embeds explicit uncertainty and dependence structure directly into genomic and proteomic predictive models.

ranked.headline: Linking H&E histology to spatial transcriptomic gene expression and cell states
ranked.summary: Contrastive and foundation-model approaches now couple H&E morphology with spatial transcriptomics to infer molecular states that are not directly measured.

ranked.headline: Network inference from single-cell and error-prone expression and protein data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications propose graph-based and weighted-network methods that infer regulatory and functional networks from omics data.

ranked.headline: Haplotypes and structural variants inferred from genotype and low-depth sequencing data
ranked.summary: Imputed and low-depth inputs now support haplotype and structural inference without parental or full-coverage sequencing.

ranked.headline: Quantifying parameter uncertainty and model selection in dynamical biological models
ranked.summary: Dynamical model studies now pair parameter estimates and model comparison with explicit uncertainty and design-trade-off measurement.
